# XDP strengthens its UK network with the opening of our new Carlisle depot 📍 🚚 · 2026-08-11T00:00:00+00:00

XDP strengthens its UK network with the opening of our new Carlisle depot 📍 🚚

We’re pleased to announce the opening of our latest depot in Carlisle, expanding our nationwide network and enhancing our ability to support customers across the Northwest of England and Southern Scotland.

This investment marks another step forward in XDP’s continued growth as we celebrate 30 years of delivering IDW freight across the UK.
